reasons_add: ʿAbd al-Razzāq reports ʿAlī counting the people of Ḥarūrāʾ among those whose efforts stray while they think they do good, without making the identification exclusive.
Al-Burhān defines the example as written paronomasia: the words resemble each other in script but differ in sound. Al-Itqān says the phrase combines dot-based taṣḥīf with vowel-based taḥrīf.
